name: content
description: Content rendered inside the tooltip popup. Accepts any `ReactNode`. Use Tooltip only for supplementary information that is helpful but not required — touch and keyboard users may not reliably reach it, so do not rely on it for anything essential (use `TextField`'s `helperText`/`status` for field hints and validation, and `Dialog` to confirm destructive actions). Do not place interactive elements (links, buttons) inside the content.

name: children
description: Trigger element. Must accept a `ref`, which Tooltip forwards to it.

name: side
description: Side of the trigger the tooltip appears on. Automatically flips to the opposite side when there is not enough space. Default: 'top'.

name: align
description: Alignment along the chosen side. Default: 'center'.

name: showArrow
description: Whether to render the directional arrow. Not shown in the game theme regardless of this value, since its pixel-art aesthetic omits directional arrows. Default: true.

name: open
description: Controlled open state. Use together with `onOpenChange`.

name: defaultOpen
description: Initial open state for uncontrolled usage.

name: onOpenChange
description: Callback fired when the open state changes. Pair with `open` for controlled usage.

name: disabled
description: Disables the tooltip entirely — it will not render. Default: false.
